question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extremely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• In this context, the phrase "work hard" needs to be modified to emphasize the extent to which people are working to make their brains smaller. The adverb that fits here must indicate a high degree of effort or intensity.
 
• "**Extremely**" is an adverb that means to a very great degree or intensity, making it the best choice to convey the idea that people are working very hard in the sense of focusing on physical appearance rather than intellectual development.
 
• Other options ("**so**", "**rarely**", "**impishly**") do not fit the context of describing the degree of vulnerability.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **So (इस प्रकार): **"So" is a conjunction that does not fit the context of describing the degree of vulnerability.
 
• **Rarely (कभी-कभी):** "Rarely" means infrequently.
 
• **Impishly (शरारतपूर्ण):** "Impishly" means mischievously.
